source: one EBTI ruling per line, valid on 2026-11-19 in the rebuilt store (extract of 2026-11-18), each outside the twelve chapters of the old store; the line's id is the ruling's reference, which the run keeps out; `original` renders the ruling's goods description closely in English, `text` is the rewrite in plain shipper wording after the near-duplicate check (feature 014a, 2026-11-19)

lines.text: Green tea, unfermented, in 100 g retail bags packed in boxes
lines.original: Green tea of the species Camellia sinensis, unfermented, for preparing hot drinks, put up for retail sale in a box with a 100 g bag.

lines.text: Chilli seasoning powder blend for flavouring chicken products, in PE bags
lines.original: The product is a red powder used as a chilli blend seasoning to provide flavour and colour to cooked chicken products, packaged in polyethylene bags for B2B sale.

lines.text: Scented paraffin candles in yellow glass jars, 2 pcs per set
lines.original: Scented candle based on paraffin, moulded in a yellow toughened glass, put up for retail sale in sets of 2.

lines.text: Nitrile rubber gloves for food handling, five-finger, wrist length
lines.original: Gloves of nitrile (unhardened vulcanised rubber), with five fingers, covering the hand up to the wrist, intended for food contact.

lines.text: Bamboo chopping boards with handle hole, single or in sets
lines.original: Wooden article for table or kitchen use, a bamboo cutting board, rectangular, with an oval hole on one side serving as a handle; sold singly or in sets.

lines.text: Single-use paper coffee cups, plastic lined inside, for hot drinks, lids available
lines.original: Disposable paper cups, coated on the inside with a thin layer of plastic, for drinking hot beverages; supplied in various versions, possibly together with a lid.

lines.text: Porcelain mugs with handle, coloured, for custom printing
lines.original: Article of ceramics (porcelain), tableware for table or kitchen use, in the form of a coloured, customisable mug with a handle.

lines.text: Glass tumblers 15 cm, machine made, not tempered, logo printed, 12 pcs/pack, for bars
lines.original: Machine-made, non-tempered glass tumbler with the trademark to be advertised on the outside, transparent, 15 cm high, for terraces, pubs and bars, in packs of twelve.

lines.text: Cast aluminium frying pans, ceramic coated, bakelite handle, 20/24/28 cm
lines.original: Frying pan of cast aluminium with a bakelite handle and a ceramic coating, in three sizes: 20, 24 and 28 cm in diameter.

lines.text: Stainless steel table knives, fixed blade, 12 pcs per box
lines.original: Table knife with a fixed blade of stainless steel, for catering or everyday household use, presented in a box of 12 pieces.
Anti-theft padlock for bicycles, U-shaped, of steel, with 2 keys; shackle diameter 14 mm; tensile strength 2 tonnes.

lines.text: Foldable baby stroller frames, aluminium and plastic, 4 wheels
lines.original: Pram frame, essentially consisting of a foldable frame mainly of aluminium and plastic, four wheels and a chassis, for transporting children.

lines.text: Sunglasses with plastic lenses, UV protection
lines.original: Sunglasses with lenses of plastics, intended to protect the wearer's eyes against UV rays.

lines.text: Quartz wrist watches, analogue dial, stainless steel or alloy case, 20 models
lines.original: Wrist watches, electrically operated with a quartz movement and mechanical display (hours, minutes, seconds), in twenty versions, with a case of base metal (stainless steel or alloy).
